items.title: Comments Open on Data Center Wastewater Permit for Saline River
items.dek: Residents can weigh in on treated effluent from the data center, which would use 20,000 gallons daily and must meet water-quality standards before entering the river.
items.judge_note: Concrete new development: a public comment period opens on a specific wastewater permit with quantified discharge details for a Michigan data center.

items.title: Coldwater Senator Says Data Centers Must Pay More for Electricity
items.dek: Sen. Jonathan Lindsey argues AI facilities should cover more than their fair share of power costs as over 50 Michigan communities enact moratoriums over grid and water strain.
items.judge_note: Incremental but real: a named Michigan state senator takes a policy position on data center electricity costs amid documented local moratorium wave.

items.title: Dowagiac Residents File Class-Action Lawsuit Over Data Center Noise
items.dek: Neighbors allege a constant high-pitched hum from an AI-focused facility has disrupted sleep and daily life for nearly two years.
items.judge_note: Class-action lawsuit is a concrete legal action with specific allegations—a clear escalation beyond complaints.
